add.title: Cloak & Dagger#10
add.text: Evita tells Tandy and Tyrone they are the Divine Pairing, and together they absorb the leaking energy at the Roxxon facility and save New Orleans.
add.whoA: Tandy's other half in the Divine Pairing.
add.whoB: Tyrone's other half in the Divine Pairing.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: Tandy and Tyrone defeat Andre for good, then leave New Orleans together to be heroes.
add.whoA: Tandy's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.
add.whoB: Tyrone's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#3
add.text: Evita takes Tyrone to her aunt for guidance, and on a walk afterward they share a kiss.
add.whoA: Tyrone's classmate and new love.
add.whoB: Evita's classmate and new love.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#11
edit.text: Alex meets Livvie, Darius's sister-in-law, while working for Darius, and she takes a liking to him.
edit.whoA: Darius's sister-in-law, whom Alex meets while working for Darius.
edit.whoB: The boy Livvie takes a liking to.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#12
add.text: Helping Darius's family move in, Alex grows close to Livvie, and they fall for each other and kiss.
add.whoA: Darius's sister-in-law, whom Alex falls for.
add.whoB: The boy Livvie falls for.

edit.text: Catherine plots with the Yorkes to send Molly away, out of Jonah's reach.
Catherine and Tina run PRIDE's affairs side by side.
edit.whoA: A fellow PRIDE member.
edit.whoB: A fellow PRIDE member.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#11
add.text: Tina kills Molly's relative Graciela to silence her, which upsets Catherine, and takes the lead of PRIDE, which Catherine resents.
add.whoA: A fellow PRIDE member, whose leadership Catherine resents.
add.whoB: A fellow PRIDE member. Resents Tina taking the lead.

edit.title: Runaways S3#9
edit.text: Victor tells Chase that Janet's mind lives on in the algorithm, and Chase works with her to take down Morgan's phone towers.
Frank is married to Leslie, the leader of the Church of Gibborim, and his fame helps make it known.
edit.whoA: Frank's wife, leader of the Church of Gibborim.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#7
add.text: Frank finds a photo of Jonah with a young Leslie and confronts her, and she admits her long affair with Jonah.
add.whoA: Frank's wife, who hid a long affair with Jonah.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband, the actor who fronts her church.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#10
add.text: Frank blames Leslie for having his memory of her affair with Jonah wiped.
add.whoA: Frank's wife. Hid her affair with Jonah and wiped Frank's memory of it.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband, the actor who fronts her church.

edit.text: Stacey breaks free of Jonah's wife long enough to warn Gert and Dale, then turns again, and Gert and Dale flee separately.
edit.whoA: Gert's parents. Stacey is possessed, and Gert and Dale part ways.

edit.text: Robert is Nico's father and a member of PRIDE.
edit.whoB: Robert's daughter.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#19
add.text: Robert helps Victor build weapons to bring the Runaways home.
add.whoA: Nico's father, who helps build weapons against the Runaways.
add.whoB: Robert's daughter.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#23
add.text: When Robert and Tina fight Nico at PRIDE headquarters, her dark powers shatter the glass around them and leave him badly hurt.
add.whoA: Nico's father, a member of PRIDE.
add.whoB: Robert's daughter, who wounds him.

edit.text: Dale and Stacey engineered Old Lace and kept her hidden in their basement.
edit.whoA: Old Lace's creators.
edit.whoB: The dinosaur Dale and Stacey built.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#21
add.text: After Old Lace runs off with Gert, Dale and Stacey tranquilize her and use her to track their daughter.
add.whoA: Old Lace's creators, who capture her to track Gert.
add.whoB: The dinosaur Dale and Stacey built, then use to find Gert.

edit.text: Tina warns Nico away from Morgan, then slaps Morgan at the WIZARD party.
A flashback shows Peter first meeting Betty when he joins the Daily Bugle.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#7
add.text: Parafino captures Betty when she comes to his wax museum, and Spider-Man frees himself and stops him while Betty gets the police.
add.whoA: Jameson's secretary, and Peter's friend at the Bugle.
add.whoB: Betty's friend at the Bugle, and as Spider-Man, her rescuer.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#16
add.text: Spider-Man rescues Betty from a shadow tiger.
add.whoA: Jameson's secretary, and Peter's friend at the Bugle.
add.whoB: Betty's friend at the Bugle, and as Spider-Man, her rescuer.

edit.text: Dormammu has Baron Mordo give Kasady a symbiote of his own, and as Carnage he goes to Stark Enterprises for the probe Dormammu needs.
Carnage grabs the probe for Dormammu, who gives him the power to drain life force and uses him to reach Earth, until Venom takes Carnage with him through the portal into Dormammu's realm.
When the symbiote starts taking Eddie over again, Dr. Kafka brings him to Dr. Connors, who frees him from it with heat and sound.
Back as Venom, Eddie attacks Jameson and overpowers Spider-Man, then leaves with Dr. Kafka.
Whistler joins Spider-Man and the Black Cat against the vampire queen Miriam, and helps stop her plan to turn people into vampires.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#59
edit.text: When Hydro-Man kidnaps Mary Jane on the honeymoon, Felicia helps Spider-Man pursue him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#62
add.text: Spider-Man brings Felicia to the Beyonder's world, where she fights the Red Skull's empire at his side, and they share a kiss.
add.whoA: Peter's partner in the field, with feelings for him.
add.whoB: Felicia's partner in the field, and the man she loves.

edit.text: Ben is hired to dig up dirt on Cat Hardy and tries to sell her the photos, until her bodyguard Flint Marko attacks him. After Marko goes missing, Cat hires Ben to find him.
edit.whoA: A singer who hires Ben to find her missing bodyguard.
edit.whoB: The private eye Cat hires to find Marko.

add.title: Spider-Noir#4
add.text: Cat tells Ben she hired Addison to kill Silvermane. They spend the night together, and she works out that he is the Spider.
add.whoA: Ben's lover, who works out he is the Spider.
add.whoB: Cat's lover, secretly the Spider.

add.title: Spider-Noir#5
add.text: Ben asks Cat to leave the city with him and she agrees, but when she hears Dr. Faber may need the Spider for a cure, she tells Faber who he is.
add.whoA: Ben's lover, who gives his secret to Dr. Faber.
add.whoB: Cat's lover, whose secret she gives away.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: When Silvermane threatens to kill Cat to make Ben confess, she admits she betrayed Silvermane to protect Ben. In the end she chooses Marko.
add.whoA: A former lover who protects Ben from Silvermane, then chooses Marko.
add.whoB: The private eye Cat protects from Silvermane.

edit.text: Janet Ruiz is Ben's secretary and fellow investigator, and she works his cases with him.
edit.whoA: Ben's secretary and fellow investigator.
edit.whoB: Janet's boss, a private eye.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: After the case is over, Ben makes Janet his full partner, and the agency becomes Reilly and Ruiz Investigations.
add.whoA: Ben's secretary, now his partner in the agency.
add.whoB: Janet's boss, now her partner in the agency.

edit.text: Robbie Robertson is Ben's friend, a journalist who digs into the same case.
edit.whoA: Ben's journalist friend.

add.title: Spider-Noir#7
add.text: Robbie pushes Ben to help the other metahumans, and when the Spider struggles against Lonnie Lincoln, Robbie stabs Lincoln in the eye with the cure.
add.whoA: Ben's journalist friend, who cures Lincoln.
add.whoB: Robbie's friend, the Spider, whom he pushes to help others.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: When Silvermane forces Ben to bring in the Spider, Robbie shows up in the Spider's mask to protect him.
add.whoA: Ben's journalist friend, who even poses as the Spider to protect him.
add.whoB: Robbie's friend, the Spider, whom he poses as.

edit.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard. He fights Ben over the photos of Cat, and after Marko goes missing, Cat hires Ben to find him.
edit.whoA: Cat's bodyguard, whom Ben is hired to find.
edit.whoB: The private eye Marko fights over the photos of Cat.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: As Silvermane's enforcer, Marko fights the Spider beside Leyden, but turns on Leyden when he attacks Cat. Ben gives Marko the last dose of the cure so he can be with Cat.
add.whoA: Cat's lover, who gets Ben's last cure.
add.whoB: The private eye who gives Marko the last dose of the cure.

edit.text: Silvermane rules New York's underworld, and Ben keeps crossing him on his case.
edit.whoB: A private eye who keeps crossing Silvermane.

add.title: Spider-Noir#2
add.text: Silvermane's men try to take Ben to him. As the Spider, Ben attacks Silvermane's car and scares him into leaving Ben and Janet alone.
add.whoA: The mob boss Ben scares off as the Spider.
add.whoB: The private eye who keeps crossing Silvermane.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: Silvermane has Ben brought to him to reach the Spider, and when Leyden recognizes Ben from the war, Silvermane realizes Ben is the Spider.
add.whoA: The mob boss who learns Ben is the Spider.
add.whoB: The private eye Silvermane learns is the Spider.

edit.text: The Green Goblin, a new masked villain, tries to overthrow Tombstone and become the city's crime boss.
edit.whoB: The crime boss the Goblin tries to overthrow.

edit.text: The Green Goblin secretly set up the summit that brings Tombstone down, and he takes over as the new Big Man.
edit.whoB: The crime boss the Goblin overthrows.

edit.text: Black Cat knocks Quentin Beck out while helping Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.
edit.whoB: Knocks Beck out.

edit.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard. When he goes missing, she hires Ben to find him.
edit.whoA: Cat's bodyguard, whom she hires Ben to find.
edit.whoB: The singer Marko guards.

add.title: Spider-Noir#4
add.text: Cat tells Ben she hired Addison to kill Silvermane so she and Marko could settle down. Marko overhears, feels betrayed and goes back to work for Silvermane.
add.whoA: Cat's lover, who turns away from her.
add.whoB: Marko's lover, who kept her plot from him.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: When Leyden attacks Cat, Marko turns on him to protect her. Ben gives Marko the last dose of the cure so he and Cat can be together.
add.whoA: Cat's lover, cured so they can be together.
add.whoB: Marko's lover, whom he protects from Leyden.

edit.title: Spider-Noir#2
edit.text: Cat sings at the Alcove, and she admits to Ben that Silvermane owns it.
edit.whoA: The mob boss who owns the club where Cat sings.
edit.whoB: The singer at Silvermane's club, the Alcove.

add.title: Spider-Noir#3
add.text: Ben works out that Cat leaked Silvermane's liquor shipment and hired Addison to burn down his mansion.
add.whoA: The mob boss Cat secretly works against.
add.whoB: Silvermane's singer, who secretly works against him.

add.title: Spider-Noir#4
add.text: Cat reveals that Silvermane murdered her first fiance, and that she hired Addison to kill him.
add.whoA: The boss who murdered Cat's first fiance.
add.whoB: Silvermane's singer, who plots to kill him.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: To protect Ben, Cat admits she betrayed Silvermane. When he flees, she tracks him down and kills him.
add.whoA: The boss who murdered Cat's first fiance. Cat kills him.
add.whoB: Silvermane's singer, who kills him.

edit.whoB: Beck helps him frame Spider-Man.

edit.text: Martha is Curt's wife and a scientist herself, and they have a son, Billy.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#3
add.text: When Curt becomes the Lizard, Martha helps make the cure that turns him human again.
add.whoA: Curt's wife, a fellow scientist.
add.whoB: Martha's husband.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#26
add.text: Curt and Martha leave ESU and New York with Billy to escape Miles Warren's blackmail.
add.whoA: Curt's wife, a fellow scientist.
add.whoB: Martha's husband.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#16
edit.text: Electro breaks out of Ravencroft to join the new Sinister Six. He and the Vulture ambush Spider-Man, who traps Electro under a pile of tires.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
add.text: Electro helps kidnap Gwen for the Master Planner, and Spider-Man stops him again in the lair.
add.whoA: Electro's old foe.
add.whoB: A living power surge Peter keeps fighting.

edit.whoA: A thief who fights the Goblin at the Vault.
A thug the Goblin kidnaps.
A thug Norman flatters into turning on Tombstone.

edit.text: Robbie digs into Silvermane's empire for his stories.
edit.whoA: The mob boss Robbie investigates.
edit.whoB: A journalist digging into Silvermane's empire.

add.title: Spider-Noir#8
add.text: When Silvermane is about to kill Cat at the Alcove, Robbie arrives dressed as the Spider.
add.whoA: The mob boss Robbie investigates and tricks.
add.whoB: A journalist who poses as the Spider.

edit.whoA: The hero Beck helps the Chameleon frame.
edit.whoB: A Chameleon henchman who helps frame Peter.

edit.text: While Peter is away, Carla and the interns test his Magnetic Generator successfully. When he turns up hurt, Carla worries and urges him to go home.

edit.whoB: One of Mila's robbery crew.
One of Mila's robbery crew.

edit.text: War Machine helps Spider-Man fight Venom and Carnage at Stark Enterprises, until Carnage beats them both.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
add.text: After Venom and Carnage flee, the hurt War Machine stops Jameson from unmasking the fallen Spider-Man.
add.whoA: Helps Peter fight Venom, then keeps Jameson from unmasking him.
add.whoB: A hero War Machine fights beside and protects.

edit.text: Doctor Strange fights an alien at Midtown High on Peter's first day, and a spider that comes through his portal bites Peter.
edit.whoA: The sorcerer whose portal brings the spider that bites Peter.
edit.whoB: A freshman bitten by a spider from Strange's portal.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10
add.text: When Norman's gateway lets the alien through, Peter helps Strange send it back to space and destroy the gateway.
add.whoA: The sorcerer Peter helps close Norman's gateway.
add.whoB: A young hero who helps Strange close Norman's gateway.

edit.text: Spider-Man saves Harry from a group of thugs on his way to school.
edit.whoA: Peter saves him from thugs.
edit.whoB: The masked hero who saves Harry from thugs.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#4
add.text: At Oscorp, Peter accidentally reveals to Harry that he is Spider-Man.
add.whoA: Norman's son, who learns Peter's secret.
add.whoB: Secretly Spider-Man, as Harry finds out.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#5
add.text: Norman brings Harry into the Spider-Man partnership, and Harry guides Peter from Oscorp.
add.whoA: Peter's friend and guide at Oscorp.
add.whoB: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#8
add.text: Harry has Oscorp's engineers make Peter a new red and blue Spider-Man suit.
add.whoA: Peter's friend and guide at Oscorp.
add.whoB: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10
add.text: Peter quits Oscorp and cannot trust Norman again, but he and Harry stay friends.
add.whoA: Peter's friend, still on his side after Oscorp.
add.whoB: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

edit.whoA: A member of Mila's crew.

edit.text: Mila uses her new helmet to break Mikhail and the rest of the crew out of prison.
edit.whoA: Mila's partner in the crew.
edit.whoB: Mikhail's partner. Breaks him out of prison.

edit.text: The Unicorn uses Mikhail as bait, but after Spider-Man saves him, Mikhail takes her helmet and the police arrest them both.
edit.whoA: Mila's partner. Takes her helmet.
edit.whoB: Uses Mikhail as bait.

edit.text: James Rhodes sides with Tony Stark over the Sokovia Accords. He corners Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers at the end of the Bucharest chase, and at the Leipzig airport he chases the Quinjet they escape in.
edit.whoA: War Machine, on Tony's side. Corners Bucky in Bucharest and chases his Quinjet at Leipzig.
edit.whoB: The fugitive on Steve's side. Rhodes corners him in Bucharest and chases him at Leipzig.

edit.whoA: War Machine. Opposed Bucky over the Accords, now fights beside him in Wakanda.
edit.whoB: Opposed Rhodes over the Accords. Fights beside him in Wakanda.

edit.text: Jackson Norriss is a Ten Rings agent who serves the group's real leader, the man behind the Mandarin name. After Trevor Slattery mocks that legend, Norriss poses as a documentary filmmaker to get him out of Seagate prison and deliver him to his master.

edit.whoA: Usurper from whom Heimdall steals Hofund and hides Asgard's people.

add.title: Blade: The Series#12
add.text: Marcus plants a bomb on Charlotte's plane, but she survives and warns the other purebloods about his treachery.
add.whoA: The elder Marcus tries to blow up.
add.whoB: The vampire who tries to kill Charlotte with a bomb.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#27
add.text: The Scorpion and the Vulture clash at Dr. Connors's lab, then agree to team up so each can be cured of his mutation, and they ambush Spider-Man together.
add.whoA: A mutated villain who teams up with the Scorpion for a cure.
add.whoB: A mutated villain who teams up with the Vulture for a cure.

add.title: Daredevil S3#7
add.text: Matt, as Daredevil, confronts FBI agent Ray Nadeem at his home and tells him the Daredevil who attacked the Bulletin was a pretender and an FBI agent.
add.whoA: An FBI agent Matt warns about the fake Daredevil.
add.whoB: The masked vigilante who tells Nadeem the attacker was a fake.

add.title: Daredevil S3#8
add.text: Matt, as Daredevil, and Nadeem break into Dex's apartment looking for proof he is the fake. Dex catches them and injures Nadeem, but they escape.
add.whoA: An FBI agent who searches Dex's apartment with Matt.
add.whoB: The masked vigilante who searches Dex's apartment with Nadeem.

add.title: Daredevil S3#9
add.text: Blackmailed into working for Fisk, Nadeem is made to lure Matt to Fisk's meeting, but Matt knows it is a trap and stays away.
add.whoA: An FBI agent forced by Fisk to lure Matt into a trap.
add.whoB: The vigilante Nadeem is forced to lure into Fisk's trap.

edit.text: Cosmo stays on in the new Guardians team Rocket leads, and calls him her Kapitan.
edit.whoA: Leader of the new Guardians, whom Cosmo calls Kapitan.
edit.whoB: A telekinetic dog in the new Guardians team Rocket leads.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
add.text: Rocket and a dog in a space suit growl and bare their teeth at each other as Carina guides Rocket's group through the Collector's museum.
add.whoA: A bounty hunter who growls back at her in the Collector's museum.
add.whoB: A dog in a space suit Rocket growls at in the Collector's museum.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: Cosmo uses her telekinesis to help Rocket rebuild Knowhere, though she gets fed up with him and asks for treats. Later they try to decorate Groot as a Christmas tree.
add.whoA: A fellow Guardian Cosmo helps rebuild Knowhere.
add.whoB: A telekinetic dog who helps Rocket rebuild Knowhere.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Peter visits Harry's home and meets his cold, demanding father, Norman. When the Vulture snatches Norman and drops him, Spider-Man catches him.
edit.whoA: Harry's cold father, whom Spider-Man saves from the Vulture.
edit.whoB: Harry's friend, who as Spider-Man saves Norman from the Vulture.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#7
add.text: A masked Green Goblin sets out to take over New York's underworld from the Big Man and tries to kill Spider-Man.
add.whoA: A masked madman on a glider who tries to kill Spider-Man.
add.whoB: The hero the Goblin tries to kill.

edit.text: During the Vault breakout, Peter learns that inmate Walter Hardy, Black Cat's father, is the burglar who killed Uncle Ben, the one Peter once caught and spared. Walter helps Spider-Man stop the escaped villains and chooses to stay in prison to pay for his crime.
In a friendly skirmish Forge sets up between X-Factor and the X-Men, Havok faces off against Cyclops, and they find that neither one's blasts can hurt the other.
edit.whoA: The X-Men's leader. Neither his blasts nor Havok's can hurt the other.
edit.whoB: X-Factor's blaster. Neither his blasts nor Scott's can hurt the other.

edit.text: Loki leads the invasion of Earth on behalf of the Other's master.
edit.whoA: The Other's master, for whom Loki leads the invasion of Earth.
edit.whoB: The god who leads the invasion of Earth on his behalf.

edit.text: The Other gives Loki his orders for the invasion of Earth, speaking for the master he serves.
edit.whoA: A hooded agent who gives Loki his orders.
edit.whoB: The god to whom the Other gives his master's orders for the invasion.

edit.text: The Other serves a hidden master and speaks for him, and hands Loki the Chitauri army to invade Earth.
edit.whoA: His servant and voice. Arms Loki with the Chitauri.
